sentence: This project studies how sleep and breathing traits vary from night to night in sleep apnea and how sex affects daytime function.
This project looks at G protein-coupled receptors to find ways to target the mechanisms that cause asthma and to develop drugs for it.
This project tries to find drug targets in cancer cells that lost a tumor suppressor gene, using a redundant gene elsewhere in the genome.
This project works to bring plasma biomarkers of Alzheimer's disease and related dementias into use in diverse populations.
This project tries to find reversible causes of immune suppression in medulloblastoma, a pediatric brain tumor, after radiation treatment.
This project uses machine learning on oral microbiome data to study how the subgingival microbiome varies and relates to periodontitis.
This project tests the safety and immune activity of RNA-lipid nanoparticles in patients with newly-diagnosed glioblastoma.
This project develops inhibitors of viruses of pandemic concern that target viral entry, proteolytic cleavage, and nuclease and helicase activities.
This project uses a brain biomarker of prefrontal activity to personalize magnetic stimulation treatment for people with depression.
This project develops cancer therapies by finding lead compounds or target structures and testing them in animal models, including dogs.
This project studies how a family of phages gets past the immune systems of bacteria so better phage therapeutics can be developed.
This project tries to find the regulators of a state where viral gene expression is suppressed in oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma tumors.
This project tries to find which Group B Streptococcus genes are needed for intestinal colonization, using transposon insertion sequencing in a murine model.
This project compares how well glucose-lowering medications work in people with HIV and diabetes, including effects on glycemic control, cardiovascular and kidney outcomes.
This project provides an imaging mass spectrometer that maps metabolites in single cells for research on cancer metabolism, microbiome host interactions, and drug discovery.
This project studies how cellular senescence affects gene expression and function of cell populations in tissues after infection or vaccination.
This project supports a community resource that applies molecular network knowledge to find pathways, biomarkers, drug targets and genetic variants underlying disease.
This project develops methods to measure protein-protein and protein-DNA interaction networks in cells and how disease disturbs them.
This project studies endosomal signaling of G protein-coupled receptors in itch and looks for targets to treat itch.
